name: acryl-kv-json
description: The JSON-file provider of the kv port: one file in the app home, rewritten atomically (temp file, then rename) on every write. Vendored from ACRYL.
mount: mount it after instance, as a row in blend.yaml (`- id: kv` / `name: acryl-kv-json`, registered in src/app.ts as 'acryl-kv-json') or as root.plugin(kvJson, {}) (the file is kv.json in the app home, or set path; a relative path is read from the app's folder); then a plugin that declares inject: ['kv'] calls await ctx.kv.set('theme', 'dark') and ctx.kv.update('visits', (n) => (n ?? 0) + 1)
